author: _aliasless_
body:
Transference II or III is good for your first slot so you can recuperate ward damage without disrupting the last 3 spell chain. I tend to use WoO, Mimics Mischief, and Golemns Fortitude then spam transference until the fight is over. You'll generally find all the other ⬆️ buffs before then end of the tower. Eventually you may want to swap to Replica Selene, she has multi target spells and can make clearing most tower fights much quicker.

Side note, I forget that I use Fallen Sky Leggings so Ward turn upkeep isn't one of my general priorities so maybe Transference in slot one is a bad idea. WoO or fortify for building turns when needed?

Edit for clarification: While Replica Selene can make the tower fights quicker, for the top floor Titan Boss you'll want to take ASG for overall damage output.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
Ward of Light is a good spell to help sustain occasionally. It'll give a ton of health and ward when you need to restore both immediately. 


For towers, stun dart is great. You can stun the raid bosses.


Try Wisp Heal 1 if you find yourself low on mana often. Cheaper cleansing might be key every once in a while.


DB2 would be a straight upgrade.

author: LordJacknife
body:
Outwill for guaranteed res down.  I'll swap this out to omnistrike III for the other realms X10HP raids.  After I have EVERYTHING set I then spam swordplay III while watching ward turns, HP, whatnot...  swordplay III will randomly give temp res down and me temp mag up along with other temps.

Alternatively, since you are using ASG, who gives triple magic up.  Swap out your damaging spells to magic versions?  Also Verse is great as it's non-elemental AND has a chance of temp def/res down.  Your faction seal spell from the deity class does decent damage and gives ward turns.  It also heals a bit.

Soon you'll have the shards and be able to switch to using hydrus and/or use replica selene.

Prism wall from the cataphract spec is nice.  
  
Personally I wouldn't use Skadi for this?  I know it can be annoying for ASG to do triple mag up when fighting a room of trash mobs, but usually it's just one turn before everything is dead.  I also use Thrud instead of Snotra so that when I do melee damage it isn't nerfed.

Like others said, stun dart is great.  Berserk mushroom is great AND makes you not necessarily need the double edge.  I will add that some titans are immune to stun but can be slept instead.  You could also consider bolt IV or perfect shot for those pesky pegasi who are low on HP.

Once you get used to regularly only doing level 50 towers, you won't need wyrm song, wyvern speed, or barrier II as you will usually get those buffs from chests before you reach the titan.
